caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-colored, rectangular object with a rounded bottom edge resembling a quilted bib or apron. It features a strap looping across the top, attached at both upper corners. The surface of the object is covered with a repeating diamond pattern, which gives it a textured appearance. At the center of the bib or apron, there is a stylized letter "B" embroidered or prominently represented. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, providing a stark contrast to the dark, intricate object in the foreground. The drawing is rendered in shades of black and grey, and every detail is clearly outlined and shaded to emphasize the texture and form. In the bottom right corner, the artist's name, "Mary FitzGerald," is faintly inscribed.
title: Quilted Chest Protection
